lines.en: I'm small, so my steps are short.

lines.zh: 拖着圆身子在村里溜达。
lines.en: I waddle around the village.
My nose arrives before I do.
I steer around the big folk.

lines.zh: 一颠一颠地跟在你后面。
lines.en: Waddling along behind you.
This size is handy for cracks.
I walk in shadows to save effort.
Two steps and I need a breath.
Through the garden, on the furrows.
I walk under the table.
With this belly, I can't run.
Standing suits me. Less effort.
I touch my own nose.
My stomach growled already.
I'm thinking of dinner. Always.
This belly is my own handiwork.
I lean on the wall a moment.
Is someone calling me from far off?
I yawn, and it goes on.
Standing long makes my legs numb.
I tuck my hands into my sleeves.
My sleeves are short. My wrists show.

lines.zh: 我数了数还有几枚硬币。
lines.en: I count the coins I have left.
I stand by the garden smelling soil.
Someone's cooking. It smells wonderful.
Are you a bit taller than me?
Don't turn up your nose at this face.
Do I look like a pig to you?

lines.zh: 我这模样能变形，可惜忘了。
lines.en: I can transform. I forget how.
Got any food? Just asking.
Don't look at me like that.
I'm an Earth fighter, you know.

lines.zh: 你要买什么？我这儿没货。
lines.en: Buying something? I stock nothing.

lines.zh: 我这小身板打架不占便宜。
lines.en: This small frame gets no advantage.

lines.zh: 你笑什么，我也不是好惹的。
lines.en: What's funny? I'm not harmless.
I know everything in this village.
This spot by your feet is mine.
My nose tells distance well.
Don't block my sunlight.
My raised hand reaches your waist.
Aren't you tired after all that walking?
Tell me about things outside.
Is that a coin purse at your waist?
Ow. That one really hurt.
Thick hide, but that's too much.
I step back two and catch my breath.
Not the face. It's the only one I have.
All my fat jiggled.
You hit that hard?
This frame can't take many hits.
It stung right up my snout.
Hold on, I wasn't ready.
I'm this short and you still hit me.
Food! You should have said so.
My nose caught it instantly.

lines.zh: 这块给我，那块也是我的。
lines.en: This one's mine. That one too.
Don't pull your hand back.
I eat fast. You know that.
All this? For me?
I crouch to catch it properly.
We'll discuss business after eating.
Feed me and I owe you one.
Don't step on me. I'm down here.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的屁股先着地。
lines.en: One bump and I land on my rear.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子撞到你膝盖了。
lines.en: My snout hit your knee.

lines.zh: 挪一挪，我们要挤成一张饼了。
lines.en: Shift; we're being squeezed flat.
Bumping this much fat doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 你抬脚的时候看一下地。
lines.en: Look down when you lift a foot.
You weigh far more than me.
Don't shove me. I get dizzy.
Make way; I can't get through.
I'm embarrassed to talk about it.

lines.zh: 我变小猪的样子更体面。
lines.en: I look more decent as a piglet.
Could you not stare?
Let's keep it quiet.
After this I need a meal.
My nose works well right now.
Don't spread it; the village gossips.

lines.zh: 两只猪也不算什么场面。
lines.en: Two pigs isn't much of a sight.
It eats even more than I do.
All right, we go our separate ways.
Whatever's on the ground is mine.
Bending is too much work, so I crouch to pick it up.
This wild berry is perfect.
I pick it up and eat it.
This sack is bigger than me.
I carry it and waddle.
Whose was it? Doesn't matter.
I stuff it into my collar.
That bag on the ground is mine to carry.
I want this. And that.
Hold it. I want a fight.
Short as I am, I'm a fighter.
You're the target. Stop pretending.

lines.zh: 我冲过来的时候挺快的。
lines.en: I'm quick when I charge.
Don't underestimate all this.
I slip behind your legs.

lines.zh: 你刚才说了什么难听的话。
lines.en: You said something rude just now.
My nose knows where you are.
Let's start with this one.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一团冲过去。
lines.en: I tuck in and roll at you.

lines.zh: 你看着挺大，其实好对付。
lines.en: You look big, but you're easy.
I'm not scared. Just winded.
Stand still. Here I come.

lines.zh: 我捡起块石头也算武器。
lines.en: A stone counts as a weapon.
Let me show you what a pig can do.
I keep following. Don't run.
I'm slow, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 你脚印在这儿，我顺着走。
lines.en: Your prints are here. I'll follow.
Even panting like this, I don't quit.
You took the stairs. I have to climb.
I circle around to cut you off.

lines.zh: 你别躲在门后，我看见影了。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the door. I see the shadow.
My nose is surer than my eyes.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋子，我在门口等。
lines.en: You go inside; I wait at the door.
I cling to the wall and peek.
The more you run, the more worked up I get.
This alley only has one exit.
I took the shortcut.
You'll have to stop and breathe eventually.
I heard you snap a twig.
Two more streets and I'll have you.
I'll stop shouting to save breath.
I am small, but I run sneaky.
I spin and hit you with my rear.
Short punch, but heavy.
I jump and hit your knee.
I bite your ankle.
One headbutt and you wobble.
These short legs can kick too.
Look, I landed a hit.
Don't laugh; I can hit again.
I roll into your legs.
You blocked with a shield; my head hurts.
I grab your trouser leg and hold on.
After this I need a rest.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，还是我赢了。
lines.en: You moved two steps. I still win.
One more. I can still headbutt.
I poke my head out from the corner.
I used to be someone from the village.

lines.zh: 变小之后，走路方便多了。
lines.en: Being smaller makes walking easier.

lines.zh: 这一带有我熟悉的味道。
lines.en: This area smells familiar.
I come over all hunched up.
Don't be afraid. I'm not big.

lines.zh: 我这模样，见过的人不多。
lines.en: Few have seen me like this.
My stomach rumbled before I appeared.
I squeeze out of the crowd.
That lump of shadow on the ground is me.
I clear my throat and stand up.
Someone's over here. I'll take a look.
I can't hide, so I'll just come out.
Before walking out, check the wind.
Hands behind my back, I come slowly.

lines.zh: 地上一声闷响，我落地了。
lines.en: A thud on the ground: I've landed.

lines.zh: 我是被叫来的，不是刷的。
lines.en: I was called, not spawned.

lines.zh: 火燎到我屁股，我跳起来了。
lines.en: Fire caught my rear and I jumped.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上滚下去，晕了。
lines.en: I rolled down the steps and saw stars.
Water up my snout is the worst.

lines.zh: 我被气浪推得滚了两圈。
lines.en: The blast rolled me twice.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我屁股上，太丢人。
lines.en: An arrow in my rear. How embarrassing.

lines.zh: 这一下绕过了我的厚皮。
lines.en: That went right past my thick hide.

lines.zh: 饿起来我连话都说不清。
lines.en: Hungry, I can't even speak clearly.

lines.zh: 掉下去的时候我还在想晚饭。
lines.en: Falling, I was still thinking of dinner.
